name: io.github.prowler-cloud/prowler-mcp
description: Prowler MCP server for security findings, scans, compliance, Hub, and documentation.

environmentVariables.name: PROWLER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prowler API key for authenticated Prowler application tools. Hub and documentation tools do not require it.

environmentVariables.name: API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Prowler API v1 base URL. Defaults to https://api.prowler.com/api/v1.
